All 7 tests pass. Here's what was fixed:

1. **`overlaps`** — Changed `<=` to `<` so touching intervals are not considered overlapping (docstring requirement).
2. **`merge_intervals`** — Changed `<` to `<=` to merge touching intervals, and used `sorted()` instead of `.sort()` to avoid mutating the argument list (docstring requirement).
3. **`find_free_slots`** — Changed `>` to `>=` so gaps exactly `min_len` are included; clamped gap start to `day_end`; added trailing gap after last busy interval up to `day_end`.
